atoms.statement: Implement title matching as a new pure function (e.g., `_window_title_matches_name`, `_title_word_matches_want`, or `_title_contains_word`).
atoms.test: Add unit tests for the new pure function covering required cases (e.g., 'Блокнот' vs 'Безымянный — Блокнот').

atoms.statement: Implement comparison using casefold() normalization and tokenization of the title, where alphanumeric characters, '_', and symbols like '+'/'#' remain part of the token, and the needle's tokens are matched as a contiguous sublist of the title's tokens.
atoms.test: Assert `_title_word_matches_want('new 1 - Notepad++', 'Notepad') is False` and `_title_word_matches_want('Блокнот', 'Безымянный — Блокнот') is True`.

atoms.statement: Use regex with `\b` word boundaries for the word match.
atoms.test: Assert `re.search(r'\b' + re.escape('Блокнот') + r'\b', 'Безымянный — Блокнот', re.IGNORECASE)` returns a match.

atoms.statement: Do not use a simple regex `\bneedle\b` for word boundary matching, as it incorrectly matches 'Notepad' against 'Notepad++'.
atoms.test: Add unit test `_window_title_matches_name('Notepad', 'new 1 - Notepad++') is False`.

atoms.statement: Support multi-word needles by matching them as a contiguous sequence of tokens.
atoms.test: Assert `_title_word_matches_want('Visual Studio Code', 'file - Visual Studio Code') is True`.

atoms.statement: Add the new classic title-match stage in `_find_window` after the existing classic exe-match and before the UWP ApplicationFrameHost title-match, ensuring the priority: classic exe-match → classic title-match → UWP-title-match.
atoms.test: Integration test asserting `_find_window` returns handles in the order: classic exe-match, then classic title-match, then UWP-title-match.

atoms.statement: Preserve the existing UWP ApplicationFrameHost title-match logic and its priority as a separate, subsequent stage, without modification.
atoms.test: All existing UWP title-match tests (e.g., `test_title_matches_want_*`) must remain green.

atoms.statement: Maintain the module's internal `(title, want)` argument order for the new matcher function, consistent with existing functions, and document the difference from the contract's `(needle, title)` signature.
atoms.test: Unit tests for the new matcher function use `(title, want)` argument order.

atoms.statement: Do not modify the existing classic exe-match logic.
atoms.test: All existing exe-match tests must remain green.
